title: Overcast Compat Test Registry
description: Canonical list of test groups and tests shared across all SDK/CLI compat suites.

slow.description: Mark a group as slow so runners can schedule it first. Groups with slow=true are sorted to the front of the execution queue, allowing them to run in parallel with fast groups instead of becoming a long tail.

suites.description: Restrict this group to specific suites. Omit for the normal case: every SDK/CLI suite is expected to implement the group, and the parity checker enforces that. Use it only when the group tests something a single tool does — e.g. cdk-lifecycle, which exercises CDK deploy/destroy and has no meaning for an SDK suite. Out-of-scope suites neither implement the group nor carry parity debt for it.

generated.description: Only legal in registry.generated.json, where it is required and always true. It is declared here because registry.generated.schema.json extends this definition by $ref, and a draft-07 `additionalProperties: false` rejects any property the referenced schema does not name. A hand-written group carrying it is rejected by the Go lint in cmd/compat (lintGeneratedRegistry).

scenario.description: Only legal in registry.generated.json — see `generated`. Path to the scenario IR file the group was produced from.

state.description: Only legal in registry.generated.json — see `generated`. candidate | gated.

parallel.description: Only legal in registry.generated.json — see `generated`. The group's tests may run concurrently with one another, bounded by the suite's own parallel-slot count; cmd/compatgen sets it on a probe group and on nothing else. A loader that ignores it runs the group in order, which is always correct.

name.description: Test name — PascalCase, matches the AWS API operation where applicable.

op.description: AWS API operation name when it differs from the test name. null = no documentation link (internal setup step).

requires.description: Runtime capabilities required to run this test. Suite runners should skip if any capability is unavailable.

skip.description: If present, the test is always emitted as 'skip' with this reason. Only use for tests that can never run in a standard compat environment.

depends.description: Names of other tests in the SAME group that must run (and pass) before this test. Runners topologically sort tests by dependency order and auto-skip dependents when a dependency fails.
